part.text:
All changes are in place. Summary:

- **`src/serve.ts`** (new): `startServer()` builds once, serves `./dist` over HTTP, injects a live-reload `<script>` into HTML responses, watches `content/`/`templates/` with `chokidar`, debounces rebuilds, and pushes `reload` over a `ws` WebSocket (`/__livereload`) to connected browsers. Includes path-traversal protection for the static file server.
- **`src/templates.ts`**: added `clearTemplateEngineCache()` — needed because the module-level `TemplateEngine` cache compiles `.hbs` layouts once and never re-reads them, which would make the dev server silently ignore template edits.
- **`src/cli.ts`**: added `serve` command with `--content`, `--output`, `--templates`, `--port` (default 3000) options.
- **`src/index.ts`**: exports `serve`.
- **`package.json`**: added `chokidar@^3.6.0` (pinned to v3, since v5 is ESM-only and this project is CommonJS) and `ws@^8.21.3` + `@types/ws`.
- Tests added in `tests/serve.test.ts` (static serving, index route, live-reload script injection, 404, path-traversal rejection, rebuild+notify on content change, rebuild+notify on template change, port reporting) and a CLI registration check in `tests/cli.test.ts`.

Verified: full jest suite (43 tests) passes, `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` (the `build` script) compiles cleanly, and a real end-to-end smoke test of the compiled CLI confirmed serving, live-reload script injection, and rebuild-on-change all work.
